bundle.protocol: Two isolated parallel slit pores; periodic x (and z in 3D), halfway no-slip walls; equal unit density; no fluid-fluid interface.
bundle.flux_definition: Volume average of phase fraction times mixture velocity; advective flux, including solid voxels in the averaging volume.

entry.protocol: Equal viscosity, 60-degree slit; open pressure boundaries, phase 0 on the left, phase 1 on the right; diffusive refinement.
entry.mass_scope: Open system: mass change is permitted and is not a closed mass audit.
entry.apparent_pressure_scope: Hydraulic inference from mean velocity; excludes no contact-line correction and is not a calibrated static Pc.

entry3d.protocol: Equal viscosity, 60-degree slit (2D) or square tube (3D); open pressure boundaries, phase 0 on the left, phase 1 on the right; diffusive refinement.
entry3d.mass_scope: Open system: mass change is permitted and is not a closed mass audit.
entry3d.apparent_pressure_scope: Hydraulic inference from mean velocity; excludes no contact-line correction and is not a calibrated static Pc.

bulk_interface.protocol: Periodic D3Q19 planar interfaces at the two rock-study surface tensions; width from interpolated chi=+/-0.9 crossings.

performance.protocol: One discarded full warm-up per rank count, then three or more sequential repetitions. Rank counts interleaved; fixed geometry and update count; one logical CPU per local rank. CPU frequency is not fixed.
performance.timing_scope: In-solver category maxima across ranks; their sum need not equal the maximum run wall time. Process time includes construction and launcher overhead. Initial collision counted as initialization, not a completed update.
performance.throughput_scope: Fluid voxel updates per maximum-rank numerical time, including MPI and finite checks. Dense solid arrays also incur streaming cost.

dataset.scope: A cropped periodically repeated numerical specimen, not a laboratory permeability reference or representative elementary volume. Refinement subdivides image voxels.

provenance.scope: Finite, periodically repeated cropped rock; two-phase flux remains transient.
